title: Best tiiiny model for session compression?
body: Happy with Qwen3.8-27B, but that xhigh thinking mode is chewing through context like nobody's business. I'm hoping I can point Hermes at a tiny model for compression, without sacrificing quality of the output. I'm thinking Qwen3.5-0.8B maybe? Anyone know of it's good at this kind of task? Or.. Are there any models specifically tailored for summary? submitted by /u/BornInAFish [link] [comments]
